name: Riedlhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Riedlhof in Wildschönau** – a family-run farm nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, where tradition meets hospitality in the most authentic way.

Here, you’ll experience the **Tirol** way of life: fresh mountain air, breathtaking views, and hearty **Tiroler** cuisine. Our farm has been welcoming guests for generations, offering a cozy retreat where you can unwind and reconnect with nature.

**Enjoy our farm-fresh breakfast** with homemade jams, fresh bread, and local dairy products. In the evening, savor a traditional **Tiroler** dinner—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a hearty **Kaspressknödel**—all prepared with love and the finest ingredients from our farm.

**Wildschönau** is the perfect starting point for outdoor adventures. Whether you're hiking through the **Zillertal Alps**, skiing on the slopes of **Ahornbahn**, or exploring the scenic **Wildschönauer Tal**, our location puts you right in the middle of it all.

**Relax in our rustic guest rooms**, each decorated with wooden beams and handcrafted details, reflecting the warm charm of **Tirol**. After a day of exploration, soak in our outdoor hot tub under the stars or enjoy a glass of local **Tiroler** wine by the fireplace.

At **Riedlhof**, we believe in slow travel—where every moment is savored, and every experience feels like coming home. **Willkommen in Wildschönau!**
